summary: demo-progression.mp4 (1440x900 h264 36.83s, 5 beat clips / 10 scene segments + end card, Kokoro af_heart 0.9) produced end-to-end via the piano-demo-video pipeline for the Progression drill and published to both spots. One capture defect was fixed: the first stats-shots Personal-bests card read Convex history which was empty in a fresh user context (bests showed dashes), so the beat was re-shot playing a live ii-V-I loop in-take before settling on the stats card — bests then read 1.57s/1.67s/Total loops 1 on screen. A second fix: progressions Personal-bests card is Convex-backed (progression-history-v1) while the log key piano-suite-progression-log-v1 renders nowhere, so no localStorage seeding was used (and the brief's 'progression log' beat was replaced by the live-loop beat). Beat clips were cut to start ON the expected state (verified by OCR at segment-local +0.5/+1.5/+2.5); script/scenes repair: two scene-match strings initially missed renamed script lines, found via scene:null/gap checks, regenerated to zero nulls and zero coverage gaps before render.

tooling_notes: ffmpeg -ss beyond EOF still decodes the last frame on these webm files, so out-of-range OCR samples silently repeat the final frame — keep sample times inside duration. The screencast buffers ~1.5-2.5s behind wall-clock UI events; scroll/settle windows must be cut with OCR, not from script timings. The brief's claim 'history/stats surface on the drill card itself (piano-suite-progression-log-v1)' is only half true: the visible Personal-bests card reads Convex progression-history-v1, and nothing renders the local progression log (components/tracking/ has no progression panel; confirmed). Personal bests go blank after every context switch if a fresh user's Convex history is empty, so the stats beat must play a live loop in the same page context. Also: casting fallback used for md5sum? none. Dev server on :3002 started and left running inside this session with port-scoped cleanup pending.
handoff_notes: Chain protocol carries to video-workshop: own dev-server port >=3002 (:3000 is the opencode proxy; :3002 was mine from this session), snapshot config.generated.ts with md5 BEFORE regen, regenerate from your own script/scenes immediately before render, assert ZERO scene:null captions AND last segment end == last caption end (per-line matching in tts.mjs breaks one scene per line and silently drops the unmatched line — check BOTH the caption-table nulls and the segment coverage), count sceneSegments, >=2s segment-fit headroom per beat, re-verify md5 pre-render, --concurrency=2, tesseract psm 11 + band crops, publish with identical md5 out/dist/public. Footprints this phase: /home/justin/piano-content/public/footage-progression/, script-progression.txt, scenes-progression.json. Progression quirks: settings persist per Convex user across shots (order matters — play default ii-V-I/C shots before any type/key switches; shots restore type and key via progression-testids), pitch-class scoring needs EXACT chord tone sets (m7 0/3/7/10, 7 0/4/7/10, maj7 0/4/7/11), prompt parser splits root/quality with /(maj7|m7|7)$/ — note the sharps-in-C/G key list is C G D A E only. TESTID map used: progression-drill, progression-type-<t>, progression-key-<k>, progression-current-chord, progression-scale-line, progression-step-strip, start-drill-btn, stop-drill-btn, reset-stats-btn, connect-midi-btn.
